decision.rationale: The successor directly tests whether a source-grounded question identifies the pinned action and exact answer spans while keeping the reviewer blind to those targets. It passes deterministic build and simulation gates without opening the sealed final set or making a provider call.
limitations: This is build-only evidence and does not establish reference-question quality or product quality.
The paid 40-batch author/reviewer validation remains separately unauthorized.
Both prospective model roles use OpenAI snapshots from one provider family and are not independent external human annotation.
The fresh pool uses open educational sources; Academia Vault, student data, and private materials remain excluded.
No 500+100 product confirmation, sealed 10,000-case run, T1 promotion, professor-fidelity evaluation, visual evaluation, or deployment occurred.
